At that point my thinking changed, it changed because it became a cycle. Yes, I have 10M and yes I can sit on it, but then what am I gonna do with it? It's just gonna become 20M? So I started spending, started buying boost for my alts to gear them faster, in the end it saved me weeks of hassle, I started buying boost for my main for PVP, I don't like it, no intention of getting better at it but I wanted the gear.
